title: Malicious code in qzi2v-tttf1-testmetest (npm)
description: The npm package 'qzi2v-tttf1-testmetest' version 1.0.1 is a malicious package that masquerades as a utility library but contains no legitimate exports. It includes precompiled native binaries and an opaque cache blob that decrypts and executes attacker-controlled code when required in certain continuous integration (CI) environments. The package employs anti-analysis techniques and targets CI systems by executing malicious code under the build identity.
